title: Fix page numbers
ask: page_bounds in paging.py works out which orders to show on each page of the orders screen. Page 1 skips the first ten orders, and the last page runs past the end. Pages are numbered from 1. Please fix it; tests are in tests/test_paging.py.
background: It returns a start and an end position, and the end must never be more than the total.
Staff have been missing the newest orders because of it.
The orders screen is the only thing that calls it.

constraints.text: keep the page_bounds function to 8 lines or fewer
no line in paging.py longer than 88 characters
give the notes a heading called "What changed"
leave no TODO or FIXME comments in paging.py
no exclamation marks in the notes
link the issue, https://issues.harbourcycles.example/88, in the notes
